descriptions.text: Dirty Little Phased Bolt. This item is broken. It must be repaired before you may use it. This is a Phased item. It is invisible. It will hide its entry point and will only be discovered if it is physically touched. The perfect ammunition for the discerning crossbow assassin. This item will cast both Temporary Amnesia and Suffering Bleed onto its victim, draining them of health until they are at 10%. A second bolt will lower the victim's health to 1%. Victims who subsequently perish will be listed as dying from an alternate source. You will not get credit or experience for the kill. …

recap.text: Katia, the train's scoop, falls unconscious off the front of the train with her health plummeting after Hekla's invisible bolt, mixed in with her regular arrows, goes into her. Carl scrabbles until his hand finds the bolt, yanks it out, then pulls a second, splintered one. Donut heals Katia. Carl dips the broken bolt in blood so its shape shows, and Silfa, holding it, goes wide-eyed but says it means nothing.

beats.headline: Mixed in with her arrows
beats.text: Katia is the train's scoop, and Donut, watching through her sunglasses, messages Carl in capitals: Hekla has shot Katia with an invisible arrow. She did it earlier too and Donut took it for a mistake. It was mixed in with her regular arrows, it went into the scoop, and the arrows are still stuck in her. Katia comes off the front of the train with her health plummeting and falls unconscious. There is no wound on her shoulder. Carl scrabbles until his hand finds something invisible and yanks, and only then does the hole in her leather appear. Donut heals her.
beats.gist: Hekla's invisible arrow hits Katia, the train's scoop; Carl yanks it out and Donut heals her.

beats.headline: No credit for the kill
beats.text: Carl pulls the invisible bolt into his inventory, finds the second one, its shaft splintered, and yanks it out too. He examines it. It is broken, phased and invisible, it hides its entry point until it is touched, and it is the perfect ammunition for the discerning crossbow assassin. Temporary Amnesia and Suffering Bleed drain the victim to ten percent, a second bolt to one, and a victim who then perishes is listed as dying from something else, with no credit, no experience and no skull. What the actual fuck? Why was she trying to kill Katia?
beats.gist: Carl pulls out a second broken bolt that hides its wound and makes victims die uncredited.

beats.headline: Bolts, Donut
beats.text: You tried to kill Katia, Donut yells at Hekla in the cab; I saw it; you used invisible arrows. Bolts, Hekla says. They're called bolts when they're from a crossbow, Donut. Katia, awake now, wants everyone to take it down a notch, and cannot understand why she does not remember. Because Hekla shot you with a scary arrow, Donut tells her. Hekla laughs, and it sounds unhinged. Bolt, Donut. It was a bolt. No, says Katia: they were both shooting, and Donut hit her with a magic missile aimed at the ghouls. She remembers.
beats.gist: Donut accuses Hekla of shooting Katia with invisible bolts, but Katia remembers Donut's magic missile hit her.

beats.headline: Dipped in blood
beats.text: Silfa insists Hekla would never have let Carl hurt her. Just like she wouldn't deliberately shoot Katia with two of those invisible bolts from her crossbow? Carl pulls the broken bolt from his inventory. It stays invisible in his hand, so he dips it in blood and holds it up, and its shape appears for a moment before everything flows off it. He hands it up to the fairy. She hesitates, grasps it, and her eyes go big as she examines its properties. He takes it back. This means nothing, she says.
beats.gist: Carl dips Hekla's invisible bolt in blood so Silfa can examine its shape.
